sections: Thirty customer pages paired with thirty provider pages

sourcePriority: Latest user instructions override the historical mission; CRM is the backend authority. This artifact does not adopt the historical mission staffing counts.

implementationStatus.verificationBoundary: This content-planning review does not inspect or certify the recovered source implementation.

localization.ctaStatus: English transcribed from the blueprint service table; Spanish and French are editorial draft adaptations requiring language review.

voice.es: Dominican Spanish; address customers as usted; use local trade terms where natural.
voice.en: Natural English adapted to the Dominican pilot; avoid literal translations and unsupported availability claims.

coverage: policies marked draft pending owner review

contentConstraints.customerConfirmation: Request received; reference, next step and edit/cancel path. A request is not a booked appointment.
contentConstraints.providerConfirmation: Application received and under review; lead delivery is not activated.
contentConstraints.pricing: Explain price factors only; do not invent prices, visit fees, free-service claims, acceptance periods or credit windows.
contentConstraints.proof: Use clearly labelled proof-needed placeholders until authentic permissioned evidence is supplied; no invented reviews, counts, logos, badges or case studies.
contentConstraints.operations: Do not invent service coverage, staffed hours, response times, support numbers, provider capacity or guarantees.

providerLeadModel.draftMeaning: One qualified request reserved for one provider for a disclosed acceptance period, charged only after acceptance. Exclusivity means the platform does not send that request to another provider; it does not imply the customer contacted no one else.

contentConstraints.providerExample: Fictional example, visibly labelled in each locale; no real contact data.
contentConstraints.contactPermission: Explain sharing with a matched provider; service-contact permission and optional promotions permission remain separate.
contentConstraints.activation: No provider calls, messages, ads, spending, tracking activation or live integrations are authorized by this planning artifact.

customer.requirement: Brand, actual service area and a functioning owner-supplied contact option.
Service-specific problem and planned city; avoid implying verified coverage.
Clear request-and-contact benefit without arrival or price promises.
Use the customer CTA; WhatsApp is conditional on approved staffed support configuration.
First step: subtype, zone and urgency; trade-specific questions only where they support matching.
Company identity and evidenced trust; clearly marked missing-proof slots during preview.
Work covered, exclusions, any owner-supplied visit charges and next action.
Describe job, request matching, discuss quote and appointment; request is not a booking.
Explain scope, materials and assessment factors without fabricated amounts.
Permissioned relevant work and authentic testimonials, or explicit proof-needed placeholders.
Five to eight FAQs covering hours, coverage, quotes, provider choice, cancellation, payment and complaints; unknown answers remain owner inputs.
Final customer CTA, concise data-sharing explanation and accessible mobile controls.

provider.requirement: Service-specific opportunity in the provider's declared areas without lead guarantees.
Relevant work types and proposed trade/territory matching.
Use the provider application CTA; secondary link explains matching.
Individuals, teams and companies; service scope, declared availability and owner-confirmed requirements.
Clearly labelled fictional lead with area, service, urgency and scope; no real contact data.
Define actual request, valid contact, relevant service, covered area, consent and duplicate checks; no unsupported qualified label.
Describe proposed exclusivity accurately and identify acceptance period as owner input.
Owner-confirmed charging trigger, price, caps, pause controls and credit terms; no invented values.
Apply, review, set preferences/capacity, accept suitable requests, contact customer and report outcome to CRM.
Authentic dated case studies or an honest process explanation while evidence is unavailable.
Five to eight FAQs covering ownership, competition, poor leads, pauses, payment, support and closure.
Final application CTA, provider terms and under-review confirmation.
